smells.finding: layer3_fieldcar.py: field_median_series() computes the median-SE formula (MEDIAN_SE_FACTOR * sd/sqrt(n.clip(lower=1)), fillna(0.0)) via groupby().agg(); relative_component() re-derives the identical formula independently via groupby().transform(). A shared _median_se(sd, n) helper would remove the duplication. Minor, non-blocking -- both call sites are correct and the algebra matches (test_relative_sigma_exceeds_bare_car_sigma / test_each_stage_carries_sigma pass), it's a readability/DRY nit not a correctness risk.
